change: PERFORMANCE: Manager tab was eagerly running all 9 sub-tab refresh functions (jobcards, timestamp, uptime, notify, breakdown, mech performance, edit records, staff roster, postpone) on every single tab open, even though only one sub-tab is visible at a time. Several of these (Uptime, Mech Performance especially) do nested scans across months of accumulated entries/inspections data, making this the main cause of slow tab switching. Now only the currently-visible sub-tab refreshes; others refresh on-demand when clicked, same as before. Should make switching into Manager noticeably faster, especially on devices with months of accumulated data.
